policy.title: Hong Kong Grants First Stablecoin License to Circle
policy.description: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority has issued its first stablecoin license under the new regulatory framework to Circle Internet Financial.

policy.title: EU Finalizes MiCA Stablecoin Rules
policy.description: European Union regulators have completed the Markets in Crypto-Assets regulation specifically addressing stablecoin issuance and reserve requirements.

policy.title: Singapore MAS Updates Stablecoin Framework
policy.description: The Monetary Authority of Singapore has released updated guidelines for stablecoin issuers operating in the city-state.

company.title: PayPal Expands PYUSD to European Markets
company.description: PayPal has announced the expansion of its PYUSD stablecoin to several European countries, starting with Germany and France.

company.title: Visa Partners with Circle on USDC Settlement
company.description: Visa has expanded its partnership with Circle to enable direct USDC settlement for cross-border payments.

funding.title: Stablecoin Infrastructure Startup Raises $50M Series B
funding.description: Bridge, a stablecoin payments infrastructure company, has raised $50 million in Series B funding led by Sequoia Capital.
